title: eludite.forge.issues input
description: List the repository's issues (the Issues window; work items on Azure DevOps): `filter` `all`, `mine` (opened by the signed-in account) or `assigned` (to it), `state` (default `open`), `labels` (all of them), `text`, paged and cached as eludite.forge.pulls is. Read. The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

items.description: A label's name (a tag on Azure DevOps).

max.description: Items per page: default 50, at most 200.

refresh.description: Wait for a fresh answer from the forge instead of answering from the cache at once.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
